title: Tranche coordination and acceptance plan for enterprise isolation features
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: define and lock a tranche-based roadmap and explicit acceptance criteria for the set of enterprise isolation capabilities (VPC peering, isolated control plane, upgrade windows, and per-customer RBAC/encryption) to support 3 pilot customers by the start of the next release window. This ticket coordinates cross-functional planning, sequences work into tranches, and produces the go/no-go checklist for the pilot wave. Background: multiple sales opportunities require a minimally viable isolation surface that can be delivered incrementally; engineering capacity is constrained this sprint, so we are proposing a tranche approach with clear guardrails and rollback playbooks.
acceptance_criteria: Tranche definitions (A/B/C) published with scope and acceptance checklist
Pilot customer list confirmed and NDAs in place
Automation scripts for enrolling a customer into isolated control plane validated in staging
Per-route RBAC matrix signed off by security and product
Upgrade rollback and backup procedures documented and tested in pre-prod
SLO and logging gating criteria for pilot (latency, errors, audit logs) defined and observable in Console

Milestone 2: Engineering feasibility spike and risk register (2026-02-18)
Milestone 3: Pilot enrollment automation and onboarding runbook (2026-03-05)
Milestone 4: Pilot cutover and monitoring window (2026-03-20)
Milestone 5: Post-pilot retro and decision on wider rollout (2026-03-30)
decisions: Adopt tranche approach (A: control plane + RBAC; B: VPC peering + networking; C: upgrade/ops hardening)
Canary window limited to 2h with auto-fallback to shared runtime for first pilot
Require completion of security gating checklist before any customer is onboarded to tranche B

risks: Network isolation introduces increased cold-start latency for certain customer workloads
Incomplete RBAC mapping could cause production rollout delays and require emergency patches
HSM/KMS procurement timeline risk (external vendor lead times)
mitigations: Measure latency delta in staging and add optimized warm-start path if delta > 20%
Run RBAC mapping workshops with two pilot customers to validate matrices early
Engage procurement immediately and prepare fallback KMS integration plan
